Baker's Life requires almost every mod from PPJA and their requirements. Without them, you will be missing some items!
[color=#e06666]
[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926][color=#e06666]PPJA - Artisan Valley[/color]

[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1670][color=#e06666]PPJA - More Recipes_A Collection of Recipes[/color]

99% of the items you see in the picture above are NOT mine. Some of the furniture is from [url=https://yellog.postype.com/]Yellog[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51171631]Gweniaczek[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/99404063]SodaCream0[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url]﻿

The windows/door are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5727458]haleatsburrito[/url]

The NPC scarecrows are from [url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222122732102]글화
[/url](And I should mention that no modifications were made, only merged according to the author's instructions. I can't find anything concerning screenshots on their blog, so please tell me if I'm not allowed to post screenshots with their mod ｡^‿^｡ )﻿

I'm probably missing a few more, please tell me if you recognize anything.



Almost all items start with the word "Baker's" to prevent any potential conflicts. You can check out [url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/machines.html]MouseyPound[/url]﻿'s database for a clear list of recipes and profits.
